srp_prompt.review_scope: Define and enforce CodeFriend principal, tenant, repository, service and paired-agent trust boundaries against supported Runtime interfaces; identify any missing primitive as a bounded prerequisite.
srp_prompt.review_instructions: Verify issue scope, explicit dependencies, actual evidence, candidate provenance, negative cases and proportional validation. Exact consumer/runtime/interface identities and actual scenario counts are retained. Explicitly verify least privilege, per-message checks, revocation, secret redaction, audit integrity, tenant isolation, deletion and fail-closed consumer behavior. Exercise implicit internal trust and connection-as-permission rejection. Runtime retains final enforcement; adapter restrictions cannot add grants. Document missing primitives and refuse unsupported acceptance; independent review resolves actionable findings.
srp_prompt.review_evidence_requirements: README.product.md; src/, tests/, conformance/; tools/validate_rd09.py; authenticated adl-runtime-policy-interface 0.1.0 artifact; accepted CodeFriend #120 outputs; ADL v0.93.2 WP-S1 contract; retained RD-09 producer/consumer proof.; exact work-product revision, changed paths, VPP/SOR and retained native receipts.
srp_prompt.reviewer_constraints: Independent exact-head review before publication. Preparation review by Planning #12 is separate from later implementation review. No duplicate builds, paid calls or invented results.
srp_prompt.refusal_policy: Reject unsupported readiness, missing required behavior proof, false completion, scope expansion and unresolved actionable findings.
srp_prompt.follow_up_routing: Return preparation findings to Worker #29 under ADL #1299; implementation findings to the sole child owner; missing owner primitives remain explicit prerequisites.
